research_boundary: Research infrastructure for in silico materials science discovery. Outputs are research artifacts. No regulatory certification claims. No clinical or human-subject use. ITAR / weapons applications are out of scope (Meta UMA Acceptable Use Policy and operator policy).
_note: Synthetic L1.5 phonon spectrum; first non-acoustic mode is imaginary at 1.42 THz, well above the 0.25 THz dynamical-stability threshold (PRD §L1.5). MLIP-vs-DFT force RMSE (0.012 eV/Å) and qmesh convergence (4.5%) are deliberately set to passing values so the unstable-imaginary-mode falsifier is the SOLE trigger.
